notes.title: Community Items Released / Future Update Plans
notes.content: [p][b]Community Items[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/74292ca60d6362b2b231aa1bfaf93e09711d3765.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to the support and interest from our players, Debugging Hero has met the necessary conditions and now features community items.[/p][list][*][p]8 trading cards[/p][/*][*][p]6 badges[/p][/*][*][p]7 profile backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]5 emoticons[/p][/*][/list][p]Card drop system: 1 card drops every 30 minutes of playtime (up to 4 cards total)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Plans[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Since the game’s release, we’ve received a great deal of valuable feedback from players,[/p][p]which has been instrumental in helping us improve Debugging Hero.[/p][p][/p][p]Although development is handled by a solo developer and updates may take time,[/p][p]but we are carefully planning our next steps with the following key focuses.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Level Design Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adding more challenging enemies that use debuffs or special patterns[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing enemies that support allies instead of just attacking[/p][/*][*][p]Diversifying enemy types to improve late-game level design beyond simple stat scaling[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding the mid-to-late game stage content[/p][/*][*][p]Adding mid-stage save points[/p][/*][*][p]Increasing boss pattern variety[/p][/*][*][p]Implementing a minimap UI to distinguish normal, boss, and event maps[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Content Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]New builds and items[/p][/*][*][p]Random events[/p][/*][*][p]More diverse enemy combinations within stages[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded variety of consumable items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Other improvements are also under consideration.[/p][p]We always welcome your feedback, so please feel free to share your thoughts on the Steam Community.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p]

Introducing enemies that support allies instead of just attacking

Expanding the mid-to-late game stage content

notes.title: Update [2025/06/09]
notes.content: [p][b]Map Clear Reward Reroll Feature Added[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/28b5279f1a18981d5a64adbf181c9f942b5b736b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You can now refresh the reward list up to 4 times.[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll charges are restored by defeating bosses.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Normal Monster Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced Strength stats for mid-to-late-game monsters and increased their damage multipliers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In the later stages, monster stats were disproportionately high compared to variable cards, which significantly reduced the usefulness of debugging.[/p][p]To address this, Strength stats have been lowered while maintaining overall damage by increasing the damage multiplier. This enhances the impact of Strength debuffs.[/p][p]Additionally, when using a Hypnosis Coin to convert late-game monsters into allies, their high damage multiplier will allow for better scaling potential.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Boss Monster Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Simplified the stat increase algorithm upon phase transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage multipliers and increased Strength stats for early-to-mid-game bosses.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Previously, when a boss changed phases, stats increased based on the following conditions:[/p][olist][*][p]If a specific stat had been heavily reduced by debugging, it would increase significantly.[/p][/*][*][p]If not, all stats would increase evenly, with the total amount being greater than in case 1.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This system was intended to reward targeted stat reduction, but due to a lack of explanation, many players misunderstood it as the boss simply "undoing your debugging," causing frustration.[/p][p]This update removes condition 1, so stats will no longer spike back after heavy debuffing.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update [2025/06/05]
notes.content:
[b]QoL Improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45431221/f6798e1fc5773742521dce8c06c21b5e9d678699.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added explanations for Debuggable Stats.
[/list]


[b]New Items[/b]

Added 3 enhancement items that only appear when you own certain prerequisite items.

Core stats such as Strength and Durability generally scale along a diminishing curve.
Some of the new enhancement items directly add a portion of the stat value to damage, creating a linear growth pattern. This is expected to enhance late-game value for builds that use these items.


[b]Grenade Shards[/b]

[list]
[*] Appears when holding Holy Grenade.
[*] Increases the area of Kirara and allies’ explosion attacks, and directly adds a portion of Kirara’s Strength to the damage.
[/list]

[b]Manual: Sword Wave[/b]

[list]
[*] Appears when holding the Basic Sword Manual.
[*] Charged attacks additionally launch a projectile slash.
[/list]

[b]Sword Manual: Strength[/b]

[list]
[*] Appears when holding the Basic Sword Manual.
[*] Charged attacks directly add a portion of Kirara’s Strength to the damage.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
